elements.description:
Native modal dialog with content, focus containment, Escape and focus restoration.
The body and the actions are the app's: the dialog's own control styles don't reach into them, so a hosted
tc-button or progress tracker renders as it does anywhere else.

properties.name: text
properties.description: Plain-text content; use content for a renderable template or element.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A line under the heading that says what the dialog is for; it becomes the dialog's accessible description.

properties.name: content
properties.description: Body template or DOM node; the element renders it inside the modal.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: The app's actions for the footer (a template or DOM node, e.g. tc-buttons); they sit after the Close button.

properties.name: closeButton
properties.description: The built-in Close button: "auto" (primary alone, secondary beside actions), "primary", "secondary" or "hidden". Escape still closes when hidden.

properties.name: closeLabel
properties.description: The built-in button's text, e.g. "Cancel" beside a primary action.

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the modal is open when controlled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled modal starts open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the user requests opening or closing.

props.name: children
props.description: Interactive React content rendered into the native dialog.

props.name: actions
props.description: The app's footer actions (e.g. a primary Button), rendered after the built-in Close button.

changelog: **Shared code:** - `internal/modal.ts`, the `ModalController` that `tc-dialog`, `tc-terms-dialog` and `tc-stories` share; - `cardHead()` gains `picture`, `pictureShape` and `keepAside`.
**`tc-dialog`** uses the shared `ModalController`. If the browser closes it on its own, focus now goes back to the button that opened it.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: <dialog> and showModal()
features.why: Modals trap focus, close on Escape and sit in the top layer.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
